subject: Information Theory
title: Information Gain
description: A quick win: understand Information Gain.

hook.text: You tested positive for a rare disease. How much did that result change your uncertainty? That change has a name.

buildup.text: Information gain is the difference in entropy before and after receiving new evidence.

discovery.text: In decision trees, each split is chosen to maximize information gain—the biggest entropy drop wins.

twist.text: Gain can be misleading with many-valued features. A unique ID gives perfect gain but zero generalization.

climax.text: Gain ratio and mutual information were developed to fix this, penalizing splits that overfit.

punchline.text: The best question is the one that cuts uncertainty most.

quiz.question: What does information gain measure?
options: The reduction in entropy after new evidence
